:::{#def-jointly-distributed}
#### Jointly distributed random variables

Random variables $\Xin$ are **jointly distributed**
when they are defined on the same [sample space](probability-basics.qmd#def-sample-space) $\samplespace$,
so that an event about several of them at once,
such as $\{X_1 \le x_1\} \cap \{X_2 \le x_2\}$,
has a probability.

:::
